common.deniedMsg: You declined this permission. In a real malicious app, it would ask again and again until you gave in.

disclaimer.title: Educational App
disclaimer.subtitle: Privacy Awareness Demonstrator
disclaimer.body:
This app demonstrates how Android permissions can be misused by malicious apps.

Every demo runs entirely on YOUR device. No data is ever uploaded, transmitted, or shared with anyone — including the developer.

This is a privacy education tool. Understanding these risks helps you make smarter decisions about which apps you trust.
disclaimer.note: All captured data stays on your phone and can be deleted afterwards.

camera.infoSubtitle: What can an app do with your camera?
malicious: Silently photograph you without any flash or sound
Capture your surroundings, home, or family
Take photos whenever the app is open in background
camera.revealDesc: I just took 2 photos using your front and rear cameras and saved them to your gallery. Open your Photos app — they are there right now.
camera.warning: I did this the moment you tapped 'Grant Permission' — and I told you about it. A malicious app does exactly the same thing silently, then uploads your photos to a remote server without showing you anything.

microphone.infoSubtitle: What can an app do with your microphone?
legitimate: Voice calls, meetings, and video chats
malicious: Listen for keywords to build an ad profile
Stream live audio to remote servers in real-time
Record non-stop with no way for you to stop it — and no sign it's happening
microphone.revealDesc: I recorded {{duration}} of audio and saved it to your device. Press play below to hear exactly what I captured.
microphone.warning: I started recording the instant you tapped 'Grant Permission'. A spyware app would stream this audio live to a remote server while you see a perfectly normal interface. You would never know.

contacts.infoSubtitle: What can an app do with your contacts?
legitimate: Auto-fill contact names when sending messages
Find friends who also use the app
malicious: Build a complete map of your social network
Sell your contacts to spammers and marketers
Send phishing messages pretending to be you
contacts.revealDesc: I found {{count}} people in your life — their names, phone numbers, and email addresses. All of this is now in my hands.
contacts.revealNoContacts: No contacts found on this device.
contacts.warning: A malicious app would silently upload every name, number, and email from this list to a server within seconds of you granting permission. This data is sold to data brokers, spammers, and advertisers.

location.infoSubtitle: What can an app do with your location?
malicious: Identify your home, workplace, and places of worship
Sell your location history to advertisers or stalkers
location.revealDesc: Here is exactly where you are right now. With background location permission — which many apps request — I could track your position 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
location.warning: This is just your current position. With background access, an app builds a complete history of everywhere you go: your home, your doctor's office, your place of worship, your children's school. This data is worth a fortune to advertisers — and stalkers.

storage.infoSubtitle: What can an app do with your storage?
legitimate: Accessing photos and videos you want to edit
Saving files you choose to download
malicious: Reading all your photos, videos, and documents
Finding bank statements and ID scans you downloaded
storage.revealDesc: I found {{count}} photos and videos on your device. I can read filenames, metadata, and the content of every single one.
storage.revealNoMedia: No media found on this device.
storage.warning: Every photo you have ever taken, every document you downloaded, every screenshot — all readable by any app you give storage access to. Bank statements, ID scans, private photos, passwords written in notes. All of it.
